verdict.rationale: The pack documents a REST API, an OpenAI-compatible subset, an Anthropic Messages API compatibility layer, and Python/JS libraries. None of these items mentions streaming, incremental token delivery, chunked or NDJSON responses, or a stream parameter. An HTTP API is a building block, not evidence of token streaming, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
